notes.title: Extinction Day Demo Now Available.
notes.content: [p][b]Hello Bio Inc. Fans,[/b][/p][p]We’ve been hard at work on a brand new game, a spiritual successor to Bio Inc., and today we are excited to unveil the demo. Enjoy hours of free content with the same atmospheric and grim vibes as Bio Inc., but this time, instead of targeting a single human, you can wipe out billions.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3836320/Extinction_Day_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b][u]We need your Feedback.[/u][/b] [/p][p]Although the game is very different and plays differently, we believe it will appeal to our fan base, and now is the perfect time to share your feedback to help shape the experience you want.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]What does this mean for the Bio Inc. Franchise? [/u][/b]  [/p][p]We also understand that a lot of people were hoping to get new content on Bio Inc. rather than a new game; the truth is that we are a very small team and we tried doing both simultaneously but we simply could not keep up the pace. We still have not abandoned the idea to get new content out for Bio Inc. but we need to release this new project before. Hopefully with a new game on the market we will be able to increase the team size and pump up more content in general![/p]

notes.title: Discover our new game: Extinction Day!
notes.content:
Hello Bio Inc Fans!! 

We are excited to announce our new upcoming title: Extinction Day. For the past 2 years, we have been working in the shadows to provide a whole new experience to our players! 

[u][b]About the new game[/b][/u]

Extinction Day is a doomsday simulator where you wipe out humanity using disasters, diseases, wars, and other catastrophic events.

[previewyoutube=Wf4WBHW0iHQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]Wishlist on Steam[/b][/u]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2682380/Extinction_Day/?utm_source=bioinc_annoucement



It’s a different take on the same genre as Bio Inc. and you will definitely notice some inspirations but in a totally different setting. 

[u][b]What’s Next?[/b][/u]

There will be Private Betas and Public Demos available in the following month so be sure to follow the game on Steam and hop-in onto our Discord to get the most updated news. 

[u][b]What does this mean for the Bio Inc. Franchise? [/b][/u]

We also understand that a lot of people were hoping to get new content on Bio Inc. rather than a new game; the truth is that we are a very small team and we tried doing both simultaneously but we simply could not keep up the pace. We still have not abandoned the idea to get new content out for Bio Inc. but we need to release this new project before. Hopefully with a new game on the market we will be able to increase the team size and pump up more content in general!

notes.title: Introducing Auto-Collect and X3 Speed Features!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28363429/70f8676d7c4f6419ac9c46c1e4a8182eed8817d2.png[/img]

Hello everyone! We're thrilled to announce two new features that will enhance your gaming experience: Auto-Collect and X3 Speed.

[b]Auto-Collect: [/b]This feature automatically gathers Bio Points for you, allowing you to concentrate more on the game's puzzle elements, especially at higher difficulties. Here's what you need to know:

[list]
[*] Auto-Collect might miss around 10% of Bio Points.
[*] With Quick Harvest equipped, the miss rate reduces to about 5%.
[*]If you've purchased the “Harvest Boost” from Resource Upgrade Options, Auto-Collect will cease to miss any Bio Points.
[*] X3 Speed: By default, the game will now run at three times the normal speed. This setting is adjustable, so you can slow it down if you prefer a more relaxed pace.
[/list]

[b]Access Requirements: [/b]These features are available to players who have reached XP Level 5 or higher.

We believe these features will shift the focus of our game from resource collection to more puzzle-solving as you progress. We're excited to see how these additions enhance your gameplay experience.

We're eager to hear your thoughts and feedback on these new features!

notes.title: We are back!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28363429/84f812445817477920fc496058bae35ca88ea884.jpg[/img]

Dear Bio Inc. Community, 

We owe you all a big apology for going quiet for so long. The truth is, after pouring our hearts and souls into Bio Inc. for years, we all hit a wall. We needed a break to recharge and find our spark again.

But guess what? We're back and more excited than ever! We've been dreaming up some really cool stuff for you:

[list]
[*][b]New Features Coming Up[/b]: We're adding some awesome new twists to the gameplay.
[*][b]Exciting DLCs on the Way[/b]: Get ready for extra content that's going to spice things up.
[*][b]Bio Inc. Hits Consoles[/b]: Yep, we're bringing our world to console gamers too!
[*][b]A Brand New Game[/b]: You read that right. We're cooking up something totally new.
[/list]

Starting today, we're rolling out the “Stability Update”. It's all about making the game run smoother and fixing those bugs. This is just step one of many amazing things we've got planned.

[u][b]What’s New in this Update:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*][b]Multiplayer is Back[/b]: Our matchmaking and Play With Friend features are up and running again!
[*][b]Server and Connectivity Boost[/b]: We've upgraded our servers, so you should see less lag and smoother online play.
[*][b]Game Engine Update[/b]: We've moved to a newer version of Unity. This should mean better performance, fewer bugs, and maybe some new features.
[*][b]In-Game Graphics Settings[/b]: Now you can tweak resolution and quality settings right in the game.
[*][b]New Languages: [/b]The game is now also available in Portuguese And Spanish.
[*][b]Bug Squashing[/b]: We've ironed out some minor bugs to make everything run more smoothly.
[/list]

Your support and patience mean the world to us, especially during our break. Your love for Bio Inc. is our driving force. We're so excited to share more updates with you soon. And as always, we're all ears for your thoughts and feedback.

[url=https://discord.gg/qPVTdYp8WC]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28363429/58394087fa50a45a4fa5fc99b14b4ac5191b7a8b.png[/img]
[/url]

notes.title: Stability Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28363429/ebee38fc474d552af4f844364b17d4ef9de6dec4.png[/img]

This update is now build upon the latest Unity 2018.1 official build and should resolve most stability issues encountered with the previous version. 

Users with the “Couldn’t switch to requested monitor resolution.” should now be able to properly launch the game. 

We have also fixed the two last Multitasks stages and they now behave as expected. 

Please note that we have also reset the season multiplayer ranking and they will now follow the calendar season (next season is Summer). 

We apologize for the delay it took to release this update, but we needed the new and official Unity 3D release to ship the update. 

Thanks for your patience and support!!

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: A doughty dozen new Steam games
notes.content:
We’re back!

Unknown Pleasures has been on unplanned hiatus as I have been grotesquely ill. The lack of communication or cover was entirely my fault, and I apologise for that unreservedly (and extend further thanks to the Hivemind for their extraordinary patience). I’m sorry.

Wait, hang on, Adam’s leaving. I can blame him! It was Adam, everyone! Shake your indignant fists.

There’s a bumper of 12 games this week, and then we’ll be back to normal. So, assaulting our ailing bodies this week: third party candidates, pugilistic ducks, and a JRPG that wait where are you going no come on, be fair.

(more…)

notes.title: Crashes Fix!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28363429/f0b358497d4207a035358fc8226df85536531b20.jpg[/img]
Hey All, 

We finally found the major issue that is causing crashes for some players. We temporary had to disable 2 “mouseover” tooltips (one in each mode) that where causing the crashes. We will soon re-update the game with the fixed tooltip engine and reinstate the tooltips. 

We also performed a few major changes to help with overall performances/crashes that should have been QA for longer but given the severity of the current crash, we decided to patch right away, and we will monitor and patch regularly until we reach 100% stability. 

If you do encounter bugs or crashes, please let us know and they will be fixed ASAP. 

If the new build is now stable for you, we would be very grateful if you could leave us a thumbs up (or cancel your thumbs down). We have worked around the clock since last Thursday to identity and fix the crashes. 

We do understand how frustrating this situation was for some of you and we sincerely hope you can give this new update a try! 

Thanks to the community and everybody who sent us they’re crash logs, we would not have been able to fix it without it.

notes.title: Full Launch!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28363429/14b8e06a3705478f152fbe72ddaf72be050dbba2.png[/img]
Hello all, 

Today Bio Inc. Redemption is leaving its current Early Access state to move to Full Launch. For the past nine months, we have steadily worked on the game, adding tons of new features and fixing bugs. Today is no different as we are again releasing a new set of features to go along our Full Launch. Below is a detailed list of what is new in version 1.00. 

[b]Versus Multiplayer[/b]

We are shutting down the Multiplayer Beta branch, merging the multiplayer mode to the main branch. We also added multiplayer all-time and seasonal leaderboards for Overall, Death, and Life. A season is three months long and follows the four seasons (spring, summer, autumn, and winter). Seasonal ranks will reset every three months while the all-time leaderboard is perpetual. Who can rank number one in Life/Death? 

[b]Gender Selection[/b]

You can now pick a male or female character before starting a match. Aside from the alternative visual representation, there are also new diseases, diagnoses, and treatments specific to each gender. 

[b]New Stages[/b]

Each campaign now contains three additional stages. Scenarios for these stages are devious and will challenge your abilities to the maximum. The last stage of each campaign is considered a "boss stage", it must be completed at Lethal difficulty and has a unique twist to it. 

This is only version 1.00. We will keep building the title based on your feedback. We do have ideas and improvements for the game but we want to hear from the community before we commit to anything. Since the beginning of the Early Access, you have been very helpful and we sincerely thank the whole community for the feedback. The amount of love you have shown us is huge (94% positive on steam) and we hope you will enjoy these new features and additions to the game. 

Let us know what you think and once again, thanks for your support!

notes.title: Multiplayer Beta Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28363429/6d8f8275ccbd702822667b9144ca0380ad2e362a.jpg[/img]

Hello friends, 

We have a new multiplayer beta update available for you guys with a few major changes. Hopefully this multiplayer version will feel more complete and balanced. 

[b][u]Multiplayer Chat Engine[/u][/b]

You now can chat in lobby as well as in game with your opponent. It should provide a more engaging experience and facilitate things like rematch and side selection. Please note that there is not sensor mechanisms for now so please be polite until we sensor you :).  

[b][u]Risks Factors/Lifestyles Limit[/u][/b]

Both sides now have a limit of 6 Risk Factors or Lifestyles they can purchase for the entire match length. This limit has been put in place to counter Lifestyles/Risk Factors shopping spree that would lead to long and boring games. 

[b][u]Bio Points stacking Limit[/u][/b]

Just like playing in campaigns, you can stack no more than 35 Bio Points before the resources system will stop spawning new resources. 

[b][u]Recovery speed and Overdrive mode[/u][/b]

To achieve a 50%/50% win rate for both sides we have slightly increased the basal recovery speed. Furthermore, in the event where all diseases have been treated (no more symptoms), the Recovery will enter “Overdrive” mode and it will increase very fast. Death players must ensure their victims is sick at all time and cannot stay idle for too long. 

Let us know what you think about theses changes and let us know if you think we are missing out on something!

notes.title: Versus Multiplayer Beta Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28363429/cc94d0aa6dd31a6b9e6efe15b1420a08d21e9c61.jpg[/img]

Hello All, 

This update is a major one. We are pleased to release the Multiplayer Beta your all been waiting for. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28363429/6d8f8275ccbd702822667b9144ca0380ad2e362a.jpg[/img]


READ CAREFULLY:

To be part of the Multiplayer Beta, close the game, right click Bio Inc. Redemption in your game library, click on properties, navigate to BETAS and select MULTIPLAYER BETA in the drop-down list. Please note that you can OPT-OUT at any moment and you will not lose your saved progress. You can also continue your single player campaigns while being in the Multiplayer Beta.
 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28363429/69ef26bb7ef753ad61592e65675fc206c1e7d7c6.png[/img]

Having the Multiplayer Beta in a separate branch will enable us to be more proactive on fixing bugs and tweaking balance without affecting the standard build. 

At this moment, the Multiplayer Beta let you play against a friend in a VERSUS, Death VS Life match. We have the intention of adding a Match-Making option with ranked play, leaderboards, seasons and more but before we add new features, we must ensure that the core experience is fun and balanced. 

We will need your feedback to improve the experience so please make sure to post it under our official Steam discussions.

Official Thread: http://steamcommunity.com/app/612470/discussions/0/2381701715712786731/

Also, since there is no match making in this current BETA, we have created an official Discord server to find other players to play with. 

Official Discord Server: https://discord.gg/3RvT5bZ

CHANGE LOG:

[list]
[*]Multiplayer Beta Including Versus Mode.
[*]Added a new event notifications system to replace game stopping panels. This option can be set to ON/OFF in options menu and will be automatically turned ON after Level 5.
[*]Added the ability to see which systems a disease is targeting in Life mode by placing your cursor over a disease node.
[*]Added the ability to have your victim to commit suicide when it has serious mental disorders.
[*]Fixed a bug where the Emergency Music would not resume after the Unprotected Sex Wheel is turned. 
[/list]


Please note that theses changes have been uploaded to both the standard and the beta builds (aside from the multiplayer in the standard build).

Having the Multiplayer Beta in a separate branch will enable us to be more proactive on fixing bugs and tweaking balance without affecting the standard build. 

At this moment, the Multiplayer Beta let you play against a friend in a VERSUS, Death VS Life match. We have the intention of adding a Match-Making option with ranked play, leaderboards, seasons and more but before we add new features, we must ensure that the core experience is fun and balanced. 

We will need your feedback to improve the experience so please make sure to post it under our official Steam discussions.

Official Thread: http://steamcommunity.com/app/612470/discussions/0/2381701715712786731/

Also, since there is no match making in this current BETA, we have created an official Discord server to find other players to play with. 

Official Discord Server: https://discord.gg/3RvT5bZ

CHANGE LOG:

[list]
[*]Multiplayer Beta Including Versus Mode.
[*]Added a new event notifications system to replace game stopping panels. This option can be set to ON/OFF in options menu and will be automatically turned ON after Level 5.
[*]Added the ability to see which systems a disease is targeting in Life mode by placing your cursor over a disease node.
[*]Added the ability to have your victim to commit suicide when it has serious mental disorders.
[*]Fixed a bug where the Emergency Music would not resume after the Unprotected Sex Wheel is turned. 
[/list]


Please note that theses changes have been uploaded to both the standard and the beta builds (aside from the multiplayer in the standard build).

notes.title: Sandbox, Unprotected Sex Roulette and more!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28363429/d2a5e32ace83423c460245dd152a6ca412675f99.jpg[/img]

Hello All, 

Since launch, we had to focus on game stability but now we are pleased to announce our first major content update!

[b][u]Sandbox mode[/u][/b]

Create custom Life or Death stages with a LOT of customization options. We have tried to give you as much control as possible to configure your sandboxes. Whether you want to simply pop a stage with no A.I and 500 Bio Points to inflict massive damage or create a very intricate Life scenario, the sandbox mode will enable you to do so. 

This is also a first step towards the Steam Workshop integration that will enable you to save and share your sandboxes and have them played by the entire community. We think you will be impress with what you can achieve with this tool. Once we are finished working on the sandbox tool, we will complete the Steam Workshop integration, support booster and even more customization options. Be sure to let us know if you think we are missing out on something. 

[b][u]Unprotected Sex Roulette[/u][/b]

It’s back! For those who played the original version of Bio Inc, you sure know what it is! Now this time is a little different and is controlled by purchasing (or not) the Nymphomania Risk Factor. Purchasing this item will drastically increase the odds of your victim to have unprotected sex relationships. You might catch nothing… or HIV… who knows! 

[b][u]More Easter eggs/hidden patients[/u][/b]

I think it is safe to assume that everyone is aware of the Trump Easter that was included at launch. Well… we had some fun and added a bunch of new ones. We will not publicly advertise them here so it is up to you guys to find them! Happy Easter eggs hunt! 
	
We sincerely hope you will enjoy the new content, let us know what you think here or in the discussions. We will now take a little time off and start working on the multiplayer and the Steam Workshop integration! Stay tuned!

notes.title: Balance + Bugs v0.90.3
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28363429/b36311505477da5ba6057033e1733225aa637330.jpg[/img]

This week’s update is smaller but will fix a bunch of small issues that where left behind in the previous stability update. We also adjusted global game balance as well as adjusting specific stages that were too easy or too hard. 
Overall, you should feel that the difficulty is slightly harder especially on “Medium”. We base our balance updates on Win/Lost ratio of the entire community for each stage. It is not rocket science and isn’t perfect so let us know how you feel about it. 

List of changes:

-Fixed the All-In achievement where all any treated diseases would break the sequence
-Fixed the Recovery Head Start booster that was simply not working
-Added string of “Difficulty reward” in the end stage panel to make it clear that the amount of skull/life is related to you selected difficulty
-Fixed a major issue where some portion of the screen would become unclickable
-Fixed an issue where a tooltip would stay “stuck” to the mouse.
-Fixed an issue where double tapping the ESC button would break the settings panel
-Fixed multiple tutorial blocking glitches.
-Fixed a major bug where the clock/game would stop in the Death Race stage
-Global A.I buff
-Significant balance changes to stages Life Internship and Death Race 

Hopefully, the game is now more stable than ever! We are working on the next major update for mid July! 

Thank you all for your immense support. Your feedback and encouraging ratings/reviews are simply pushing us to work harder!


************************************************************************
UPDATE 0.90.4
************************************************************************

Hello All,

Some of you still had a few issues so we patched again on Friday June 23 with update 0.90.4. 

-Fixed bug where some users would get Pink textures in U.I
-Fixed a bug where the game would not start at the beginning of a new stage
-Fixed a bug where some portion of the screen would become unclickable
-Fixed some localisation issues


Cheers! (with a Gin martini, of course!)

notes.title: Stability Update 0.90.2
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28363429/045a7c0867c14c0a3010cd1e6f927c02b2d06ffb.jpg[/img]

We pushed live a new “stability” update a few minutes ago. This update is mostly bug fixes and small improvements. Hopefully this one is the last stability update before we can push out more exciting content. We are working on cool stuff coming very soon! 

Update 0.90.2 details: 

-Added a “Restart Stage” button in the settings panel (in-game)
-Added a “Show Blood” settings in the in-game settings panel to toggle on or off blood “splashes”
-Death: Clicking on a system in the lower Bio Map panel under risk factors or recovery will now navigate to the appropriate system.
-Balance: Adjusted game difficulty on stages Life Internship and Death Race.
-Score validation system to protect leader-boards integrity.

-Fixed a bug where starting the game would show a black screen
-Fixed an issue where stage would not start
-Fixed the broken “Stabilized” achievement
-Fixed multiple key binding issues
-Fixed multiple tutorial blocking issues
-Fixed multiple minor U.I text/scaling issues
-Numbers, dates and time strings now properly localized in all languages
-Fixed an issue where upon loading an existing game, the patient/victim name would not update accordingly.
-Fixed multiple issues where clock (days) would stop running

There is other small bug fixes and improvements coming soon but we are now working on new and more exciting content!

notes.title: Bio Inc. Redemption Now Available in Early Access!
notes.content:
Bio Inc. Redemption is now available for everyone and we need your feedback to improve the game. 

We are a small team of dedicated developers and we want to create a long-lasting experience for Bio Inc. Redemption. We would love to hear what you have to say about the game and what we can do to improve it. More stages? New diseases? Multiplayer? You tell us!

We will be listening to your voice so please do not hesitate to post in discussions forums and to leave reviews. It means the world to us.  

We sincerely hope you will enjoy the game!

The DryGin Studios Team.
